The geographic context of the sediment sites: water depth, distance to the coast, and
distance to the nearest Norwegian aquaculture site. Pick an attribute in the sidebar.
The aquaculture sites themselves are on the [Aquaculture Map](./aquaculture-map.qmd).

{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
L = require("https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js")

home_lat = 65
home_lng = 10
home_zoom = 3

views = [
  { label: "Distance to coast",       column: "dist_to_coast",       unit: "km" },
  { label: "Depth",                   column: "depth",               unit: "m" },
  { label: "Distance to aquaculture", column: "dist_to_aquaculture", unit: "km" }
]
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar
viewof selected_view = Inputs.select(views, {
  label: "Attribute:", format: d => d.label, value: views[0]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill

map_data = db.query(`
  SELECT latitude, longitude, ${selected_view.column} AS val
  FROM site
  WHERE ${selected_view.column} IS NOT NULL
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
`)

value_extent = d3.extent(map_data, d => d.val)
value_min = value_extent[0] ?? 0
value_max = value_extent[1] ?? 1

colorScale = d3.scaleSequential().domain([value_min, value_max]).interpolator(d3.interpolateViridis)
fmtVal = v => v == null ? "N/A" : `${v.toFixed(1)} ${selected_view.unit}`

{
  const container = html`<div class="map-container"><div id="map"></div></div>`
  yield container

  if (!container._map) {
    const map = L.map(container.querySelector("#map"), { zoomControl: true })
      .setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }).addTo(map)

    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "topleft" },
      onAdd(map) {
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("a", "leaflet-home-button")
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
        btn.title = "Reset view"
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, "click", e => {
          L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e); map.setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
        })
        return btn
      }
    })
    new HomeControl().addTo(map)

    const LegendControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "bottomright" },
      onAdd() { const d = L.DomUtil.create("div", "legend"); d.id = "map-legend"; return d }
    })
    new LegendControl().addTo(map)

    container._map = map
    container._markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map)
  }

  const { _map: map, _markers: markers } = container
  const legendEl = map.getContainer().querySelector("#map-legend")
  if (legendEl) {
    const g = d3.range(0, 1.01, 0.25).map(t => d3.interpolateViridis(t)).join(",")
    legendEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="legend-title">${selected_view.label}</div>
      <div class="legend-bar" style="background:linear-gradient(to right,${g})"></div>
      <div class="legend-labels"><span>${fmtVal(value_min)}</span><span>${fmtVal(value_max)}</span></div>`
  }

  markers.clearLayers()
  for (const d of map_data) {
    if (d.val == null) continue
    const circle = L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
      radius: 5, fillColor: colorScale(d.val),
      color: "#333", weight: 0.6, opacity: 1, fillOpacity: 0.8
    })
    circle.bindTooltip(`${selected_view.label}: ${fmtVal(d.val)}`, { sticky: true })
    markers.addLayer(circle)
  }
}

md`**${selected_view.label}** · **${map_data.length}** sites`
```
